setup.text:
[Kumi goal] make the bass warm

This is a goal: Kumi keeps searching until it gets there. Set the search up: listen to the reference, then build 3–4 genuinely different candidates, each on a new track named "Kumi · Goal · <idea>" (different base instruments such as Operator, Wavetable, Drift, Collision or a Simpler sample; serial chains against parallel racks), with the part on each, and audition them together against the reference once. Then stop: Kumi's own search takes over from there, trying knob settings on your candidates by the hundred, and comes back to you for bigger ideas.

When the producer gave nothing to compare with (no audio file, clip in the Set or video), there's nothing to search toward: do what they asked as an ordinary request instead, completely (every tool is yours: set the knobs, add rack chains, load devices into them, rename), and don't audition.
